title: Silver Plus: Exclusive perks and features
summary: This document describes Silver Plus included perks: built-in savings goals tracking, automatic round-up savings on linked debit purchases (round-ups move to savings automatically), and a Direct deposit APY bonus of 0.25% added on top of the base APY tier when direct deposit is active.
